focal_tasks.note: Interactive orchestrated task trapped awaiting interactive claim
Orphan claim lease with expired token

identified_defects.description: Orchestrated tasks revert to generic awaiting_ide_claim instead of respecting awaiting_antigravity_claim or awaiting_cursor_claim precedence.
Calling os.kill(pid, 0) blindly assumes worker is on local host. If worker is on remote Intel host (ralphi-ia-ver-10), local check is invalid and risks falsely terminating remote tasks.

Worktrees created via git worktree add contain a .git file ('gitdir: /path/to/real/gitdir') instead of a .git directory. Recovery checks (wt_path / '.git' / 'index.lock') fail to detect active locks in linked worktrees.
Database updates in recovery do not enforce atomic CAS (update_one matched status, token, lease_until, revision with modified_count == 1), risking split-brain duplicate claims.
Tasks with recent heartbeat (< 180s) or active local PID must never be recovered even if lease_until is in the past.
